title: The Greatest Miracle
description:
If you aren't a Cleric, you can now **Cast a Spell**+wis with an effect under the Life Domain, which you get from a deity. For more details, see the Cleric Starting Move, **Invoke the Divine**.

If you're a Cleric, you can add **Life** (or another Domain from Invoke the Divine) to your deity's Domains.

outcomes.text: Whenever you try to **Cast a Spell** to restore someone's HP, increase the dice size rolled one step
When someone else **Faces Death** in your presence, you may parley with Death and grant the agonizing character access to the following option:
bullets: Revivified — You're no longer Helpless and you recover half your max HP

outcomes.text: If they choose this option, you cannot use this Move again until you've settled your deal with Death.

title: Emotional Transference
description: When you **touch someone else and offer yourself as a sacrifice**, erase 1 Depth with your deity so they clear Conditions up to your wis. For each Condition they clear, you mark one.

outcomes.text: No one will attack you directly and unprovoked, unless they've seen you fight or have a score to settle. When you **Pull Strings**, you get access to the following approach:
bullets: If you implore them to turn away from violence, they might get away now or change their mind later.

title: Mass Cure Wounds
description: When you **proclaim your faith**, erase 1 Depth with your deity to restore half of your and your **close** allies lost HP (rounded down).
